videos.title: Tokens, variables, and styles - Update: Introduction to design systems
videos.why: Primitive, semantic and component-specific tokens explained from 4:22, then dark mode and spacing tokens at 10:39; the same three tiers as this lesson's token figure, worth watching before lab-tokens.

videos.title: Brad Frost: Is Atomic Design Dead? – Hatch Conference Berlin 2023
videos.why: Ten years after Atomic Design, its author asks whether building interfaces from small reusable parts still holds up, and what AI-generated content changes; the longer talk for this lesson.

podcasts.episode: What are Design Tokens? with Jina Anne
podcasts.why: Jina Anne, who helped popularise design tokens, explains what they are, what problem they solve and how they fit into an existing design system.

podcasts.episode: What is a Government Design System? with Amy Hupe
podcasts.why: How the GOV.UK Design System is used across UK government and how that differs from commercial work; the system is public, so you can open it while you listen.

reads.title: Design Systems 101
reads.why: Defines a design system as a repository plus the people who manage it, and separates the style guide, component library and pattern library; good vocabulary for prompts.

reads.title: Atomic Design Methodology
reads.source: Brad Frost, Atomic Design (free online book, chapter 2)
reads.why: Atoms, molecules, organisms, templates and pages explained with real examples; read it with your own components folder open and sort what you already have into those levels.

reads.title: Design Tokens Community Group
reads.why: The group behind the shared JSON format for tokens, whose first stable version arrived in 2025; the adopters list (Figma, Penpot, Sketch, Style Dictionary and others) shows why the format is worth following.
